```
module page_title_length
  purpose: Download a web page and count characters in its title element.

import std.http as web
import std.regex

public function title_length(url: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with NoTitle
  needs network.http
  expose as tool
  purpose: Download a web page and return the character count of its title element.
  example: title_length(url: "https://example.com") is 13

  let html be web.get(url: web.Url(url)) otherwise fail
  let title_pattern be std.regex.compile(pattern: raw "<title>([^<]*)</title>")
  let matches be title_pattern.find_all(text: html)
  
  match matches
    when first_match then
      let title_text be first_match.group(index: 1) otherwise fail with NoTitle
      return title_text.length
    otherwise fail with NoTitle
  end
end

public type NoTitle
  purpose: The web page has no title element.
end
```

```
module page_title_length
  purpose: Download a web page and count characters in its title element.

import std.http as web
import std.regex

public function title_length(url: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with NoTitle
  needs network.http
  expose as tool
  purpose: Download a web page and return the character count of its title element.
  example: title_length(url: "https://example.com") is 13
```

```
  let page be web.get(url: web.Url(url)) otherwise fail
  let title_match be std.regex.find(pattern: raw "<title>([^<]*)</title>", text: page)
  match title_match
    when some(match) then
      let title_text be match.group(index: 1)
      return title_text.length
    when nothing then
      fail with NoTitle(url: url)
  end
end

public type NoTitle
  purpose: The downloaded page has no title element.
  has url: Text
end
```
